contentPattern: Each row with 2 cells is one marquee item: cell 1 = image (logo or photo, optional), cell 2 = word/short phrase (optional). The items are repeated into three horizontally scrolling tracks (alternating direction, staggered start). A single-cell row is the caption (rich text, e.g. date - time - venue) shown below the tracks.
reuseGuidance: Use for animated, ticker-style word walls. Author each word and each image as its own item (or one item with both). 'light' is the light-background color-scheme hook (photo tokens); default uses the event color background. Animation stops under prefers-reduced-motion.
usageDescription: Event / campaign hero with oversized scrolling words interleaved with logo squares or photos, plus a date/venue caption line.
